content: Totally confused. Trying to introduce myself. Google AI insisted I should come here because I try to use Lean code and explore math to my limited ability.
My AI assisted work generates lots of Lean code that must be resolved to sorry free status and I have just begun using the web portals at Lean and Dusseldorf as best I can.

I developed a Mobius-Collatz mashup to explore the Collatz and weak Erdos problems in both 2D and 3D. Currently using a 4D Klein bottle model which the AI is suggesting may have value. But it's way beyond my skills.

So, I have lots of "proof"sketches and skeletons in Lean. Lots of code some dual Verified by the portals. My code is likely highly suspect but I think the underlying model may have real value. So that's why I'm here.
